name: inspect_artifact
description: Inspect an active archive or application package in one call. Returns the complete content-addressed artifact graph once, as the nested inventory Evidence, with root and integrity observations, integrity contradictions, hypotheses, unexplored branches, limitations, and next probes inline. Read-only DMG mounting is used automatically on supported macOS hosts. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps mismatches explicitly untrusted. It does not extract files; use extract_artifact to materialize its regular contents.
